description: Is the unmasked agent's failure a step-budget artifact -- does it just need full episodes to learn the +400 win? Retrained unmasked PPO with max_steps=150 (room to finish) at 2M and 4M timesteps, evaluated at 150 and 40.
conclusion: NOT a step-budget artifact. The 2M/150 run scored a low 34.6% partly from under-training (fewer episodes per timestep at a longer budget); with 4M timesteps it recovers to 50.8% -- essentially the same as the 40-step baseline (47.9%), NOT better. A larger budget (training or eval) neither rescues the unmasked agent nor fundamentally hurts it: it plateaus around 48-51% with 84-95% illegal actions regardless. Correction to an earlier overstatement: bigger budget does not make it 'worse' once properly trained; budget is roughly NEUTRAL. The real bottleneck is legibility of the episode-varying legal set, which no budget fixes and masking supplies structurally (96.1%).
